wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.description: Hardy grain for flour and bread; tolerates light frost.

potatoes.name: Potatoes
potatoes.description: Quick food crop; wet soil needs gravel drainage. Surplus makes compost or hearty meals.

hops.name: Hops
hops.description: Thirsty climbing crop for the brewery; water through dry spells.

grapes.name: Grapes
grapes.description: Slow, frost-sensitive vines for wine; avoid waterlogged ground.

tea.name: Tea
tea.description: Moisture-loving leaves for packed tea; irrigation helps in summer.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.description: Long warm-season crop for roasting; frost is its greatest risk.
